the role of tyrosine phosphorylated proteins in the regulation of vascular tone.
the role of protein tyrosine phosphorylated in the regulation of cyclooxygenease activity in newborn pig cerebral endothelial cells.
the regulation of the cyclooxygenase enzymes, which catalyze the rate-limiting step in the synthesis of prostaglandin (PG) endoperoxides.
